subject: Exec intro + sponsor fallback rotation for Raynor Cloud briefing
messages:
From: Alexandra Mills <alexandra@raynorcloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Pat Harris <pat.harris@raynorcloud.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — exec intro + 30m briefing (VP or CIO)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this. We’re preparing a short executive briefing to evaluate Redwood Inference for latency-sensitive inference at Raynor Cloud. Ideally we’d like VP-level presence (VP Product or CIO) for a 30-minute run-through that covers: current infra pain points, expected SLAs, and a short live demo of a 1M-token/day workload.

Suggested windows (PST):
- Tue 13 Aug 10:00–10:30 or
- Wed 14 Aug 18:00–18:30 (we can do an evening slot to include APAC stakeholders)

If VP-level attendance isn’t possible, CIO or a VP delegate that can sign off on proc/ops would work. Can you confirm who would sponsor from Redwood and what fallback plan looks like if the VP needs to drop?

Also attached: a one-pager on our current infra footprint and a placeholder for the NDA if needed.

Best,
Alexandra Mills
Head of Platform Strategy | Raynor Cloud

P.S. We prefer sessions recorded for internal notes, unless you have policy reasons not to.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alexandra Mills <alexandra@raynorcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Aug 2029 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — exec intro + 30m briefing (VP or CIO)

Alexandra — thanks for the details and the slides. We can cover the agenda you outlined in 30 mins.

Sponsor and fallback plan from our side: Ben Carter (VP, Customer Solutions) will be the primary sponsor for the briefing. If Ben’s VP-level calendar blocks, he’ll hand off to Marissa Cole (Sr. Solutions Engineer) for the demo portion and remain available to join in the final 10 minutes for commercial/Q&A. If both are constrained, I will step in as the exec liaison to make sure procurement/SLAs are addressed.

Concrete proposal: hold Wed 14 Aug 18:00–18:30 PT as the primary slot (that evening window works for your APAC team). We’ll send a calendar hold and update it when final attendees confirm.

Recording: happy to record for internal note-taking — Ben, Marissa, any constraints?

I attached a short mutual action plan (MAP) with the key owners and pre-reads. Please review and flag anything missing.

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Aug 2029 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — exec intro + 30m briefing (VP or CIO)

Karthik / Marissa — quick note to confirm I’ll own the sponsor lane. I’m available 14 Aug 18:00 PT and can join for full 30 mins. If something urgent comes up, Marissa will run the demo and I’ll dial in at the last 10 for SLA/pricing/next steps.

Agenda I suggest (30m):
- 5m introductions & context (Alexandra / Raynor stakeholders)
- 10m demo (Marissa) — focused on 99th pct latency and burst handling
- 10m performance / cost Q&A (Ben)
- 5m mutual action plan and next steps

Recording: fine to record for you, Raynor. We’ll annotate the recording and redact customer-specific telemetry if needed before we share internally.

Marissa — I’ll loop you into Raynor’s pre-read and the MAP; please prepare a 10-minute live demo that highlights: continuous batching, KV cache hits, and fallback routing.

Ben Carter
VP, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference

Attachment: mutual-action-plan-v1.xlsx (MAP owner columns filled)

From: Alexandra Mills <alexandra@raynorcloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Pat Harris <pat.harris@raynorcloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Aug 2029 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — exec intro + 30m briefing (VP or CIO)

Thanks — that plan works for us. We’ll confirm internal attendees but tentatively holding Wed 14 Aug 18:00–18:30 PT. Recording is OK.

Two quick asks before the meeting:
1) Can you add a brief slide on data handling (what stays in KV cache, retention, and redaction steps) so our security reviewer has a concrete item to scan?
2) Please send a calendar invite with the Google Meet link and attach the MAP and the intro slide deck.

We’ll try to have our CIO (Vikram Rao) on the call; if he has to drop, our Head of Platform (Pat Harris) will remain as the exec sponsor.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the demo.

Alexandra Mills
Head of Platform Strategy | Raynor Cloud

Referenced attachment: Raynor-Intro-Slides.pdf (sent earlier by Raynor)
